title: Who owns the shared future?
lines: Several independent firms could build one trusted brand without handing their future to a single owner.
Decentralised Brands proposes shared rules for that name while its members keep control of their own work.

title: The powers behind participation
lines: The hard question is who may change the rules, remove a member, or sell what everyone helped build.
The book follows those powers through ownership, records, common resources, and the practical freedom to leave.
